Calendar sets are rebuilt, so making and switching between groups of calendars, like Work or Family, is quicker and clearer.

## Calendar sets

- Create and edit sets in a sheet with a name, an icon, and a checklist of calendars grouped by account. Daybar suggests an icon based on the name, and tells you if a name is already taken or if no calendar is chosen.
- Changes save only when you click Create or Save. Settings no longer jumps around or slows down while you edit.
- Right-click a set to show it in the panel, duplicate it, move it, or delete it. Drag a set to reorder the list.
- The calendars button in the panel shows the active set's icon. Its menu lists your sets, and a "Calendars in Work" submenu shows which set a checkbox changes.
- When a Focus filter is choosing your calendars, the menu says so.

## Fixes

- The FaceTime camera in the menu bar is no longer squeezed out of shape.

## Install

Download `Daybar.dmg` below, open it, and drag Daybar to your Applications folder, replacing the old version. Daybar needs macOS 27 or later.

The app and disk image are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. To check your download, compare it with `Daybar.dmg.sha256`, or verify its build provenance:

```sh
gh attestation verify Daybar.dmg --repo firatciftci/daybar
```
